reason: The estimate (0.12, N=661) comes from a central-region subsample with 1% outcome trimming. Neither restriction is justified, and the report treats them as one pre-chosen specification. No post-treatment controls are used, and the pre-period outcome is controlled for. On the full sample of 2000 firms the estimate is about -0.28 (SE 0.24, p=0.24), so the point estimate changes sign. 'No effect' is also stronger than a wide-CI null supports, so the report should be redone on the full sample.
